authority.excluded_worktrees_rule: Other worktrees are inventory evidence only and are neither cleanliness prerequisites nor modification targets.
authority.selection_rule: Every recursive blob in the accepted starting tree exactly once, sorted by raw Git path bytes.

nonclaims: Classification is governance metadata, not scientific interpretation.
This manifest authorizes no implementation, staging, reset, cleaning, commit, push, or worktree mutation beyond later separately authorized implementation paths.

reconstruction.route_1: git ls-tree -r plus git cat-file object payload at exact base
reconstruction.route_2: git archive of exact base into a new isolated temporary directory plus independent filesystem raw-byte hashes; compare every path, mode, byte count, sha256, and reconstructed Git blob

classification_projection.encoding: canonical JSON with Unicode code-point key order, no insignificant whitespace, and one final LF
classification_projection.rule: canonical JSON plus LF of [path,mode,git_object,raw_sha256,byte_count,classification] rows

identity_projection.encoding: canonical JSON with Unicode code-point key order, no insignificant whitespace, and one final LF
identity_projection.rule: canonical JSON plus LF of [path,mode,git_object,raw_sha256,byte_count] rows

path_projection.rule: UTF-8 paths joined by LF with one final LF
